title: RTX Corporation Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q2 Form 10-Q remains latest operating filing; it reports USD 289 billion backlog, USD 8.305 billion cash and USD 37.383 billion debt.
summary: The unchanged filing remains the primary source for backlog, segment economics, cash flow, debt, share count, fixed-price risk, and Pratt remediation analysis.
